title: Bounded Git adapter
responsibility: Runs Git commands in the configured repository with bounded execution, Git-specific authentication variables, and text, byte, or status-returning interfaces.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Directory used as cwd for every Git child process; the constructor stores it without checking that it is a repository.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.run.args
inputs.description: Git arguments supplied as separate argv entries, without shell parsing or interpolation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.run.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, Git child-environment overrides, timeoutMs, and maxBuffer; cwd remains the adapter root and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is forced to 0. The default timeout follows gitDeadline, maxBuffer defaults to 128 MiB, and supplied numeric bounds must be positive safe integers no greater than 2147483647.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes.args
inputs.description: Git arguments supplied as separate argv entries, without shell parsing or interpolation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, Git child-environment overrides, timeoutMs, and maxBuffer; cwd remains the adapter root and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is forced to 0. The default timeout follows gitDeadline, maxBuffer defaults to 128 MiB, and supplied numeric bounds must be positive safe integers no greater than 2147483647.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt.args
inputs.description: Git arguments supplied as separate argv entries for a probe where a nonzero exit should become undefined rather than a Git command error.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, Git child-environment overrides, timeoutMs, and maxBuffer; cwd remains the adapter root and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is forced to 0. The default timeout follows gitDeadline, maxBuffer defaults to 128 MiB, and supplied numeric bounds must be positive safe integers no greater than 2147483647.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.exec.args
inputs.description: Git arguments passed as separate argv entries directly to the git executable, without shell parsing or interpolation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.exec.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, Git child-environment overrides, timeoutMs, and maxBuffer; cwd is always the configured repository root and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is forced to 0. The default timeout follows gitDeadline, maxBuffer defaults to 128 MiB, and supplied numeric bounds must be positive safe integers no greater than 2147483647.

inputs.name: gitVerb.args
inputs.description: Git argv scanned for a subcommand. The parser skips one following argument for recognized value-taking global options, then returns the first non-option argument or undefined if none exists.

inputs.name: gitDeadline.args
inputs.description: Git argv scanned for a subcommand after recognized value-taking global options. No detected verb and the configured long-verb set use the long deadline; every other detected verb uses the local deadline.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.run
outputs.description: Successful stdout decoded as UTF-8 with surrounding whitespace removed; a nonzero Git exit rejects with a Git command error.
examples:
On branch main
nothing to commit, working tree clean

outputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes
outputs.description: The stdout Buffer from a successful Git exit, returned without decoding or trimming. A nonzero Git exit throws the Git command error.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt
outputs.description: Successful stdout decoded as UTF-8 with surrounding whitespace removed, or undefined for any nonzero Git exit. It still rejects if bounded process execution fails.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.exec
outputs.description: The bounded process result containing the exit code, stdout Buffer, and stderr text. A nonzero Git exit remains in the result rather than becoming a Git command error.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.isRepository
outputs.description: True only when git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree succeeds and its trimmed stdout equals true; otherwise false.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: On a nonzero Git exit, bytes throws an Error and run propagates it; the message is git <args joined by spaces> failed: <trimmed stderr>. attempt returns undefined and exec returns a GitResult with its nonzero code instead of throwing this Git command error.

errors.name: Bounded command failure
errors.description: The bounded child can reject on launch errors, timeout, abort, or output-limit failure; timeoutMs and maxBuffer must each be positive safe integers no greater than 2147483647. exec propagates bounded execution failures, and the higher-level methods propagate them when they do not handle a nonzero exit.

outputs.name: gitVerb
outputs.description: The first non-option argv entry after values for recognized value-taking global options have been skipped, or undefined when no such entry exists.

inputs.name: gitDeadline.args

outputs.name: gitDeadline
outputs.description: The selected Git deadline in milliseconds: 21600000 when no verb is detected or a configured long verb is detected, and 1800000 for every other detected verb.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Directory used as cwd for every Git child process; the constructor stores it without checking that it is a repository.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.constructor
outputs.description: New adapter instance retaining the supplied root for Git process working directories; the constructor does not check repository status.
